title: Washing day
subtitle: Swipe down to slide. Bounce on the cot.

sections.name: WashingYard
sections.note: Washing day: sarees drying behind the lane, the rooster ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstLine
sections.note: The first clothesline: swipe down and slide under; the low mangoes show the way.

sections.name: Pots
sections.note: A pot stack: the jump again.

sections.name: TwoLines
sections.note: Two clotheslines 8 m apart: slide, up, slide.

sections.name: FirstCot
sections.note: The rope cot: run into it and bounce; a feather at the top for a double jump.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: a wave of mangoes and the first chilli.

sections.name: LinePots
sections.note: A clothesline, then a pot stack: slide, then jump.

sections.name: Cart
sections.note: The bullock cart: onto its bed and off; a feather above it.

sections.name: CotLine
sections.note: The cot, then a clothesline: bounce, land, slide.

sections.name: DogLine
sections.note: The sleeping dog, then a clothesline.

sections.name: LinePuddle
sections.note: A clothesline, then the hand-pump puddle.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: CotPots
sections.note: The cot, then a pot stack after the landing.

sections.name: ThreeLines
sections.note: Three clotheslines in a row: slide, slide, slide. A feather over the middle one.

sections.name: DungPots
sections.note: Dung, then pots: tap, jump.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: The puddle; the rooster knocks the pots off their stand; a clothesline after.

sections.name: CotLineCot
sections.note: Cot, clothesline, cot.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A breather and a chilli.

sections.name: LineDogLine
sections.note: Clothesline, dog, clothesline.

sections.name: LastCart
sections.note: The last cart, and pots after it.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: Clothesline, pots, the cot, a clothesline, dung: everything once more.

sections.name: OpenLane
sections.note: The lane opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 500 m.
